reviewer: Codex /root/chron_1_5 (AI-assisted supplied-English author review of 1 Chronicles 1–5)
review_method: I read all 205 complete actual supplied-English source units in 1 Chronicles 1–5, with actual chapter counts 42/55/24/43/41, then each proposed retained target passage and necessary local context. The initial immutable TSV had 197 proposed pairs. I separately read all 197 complete source/target/category/rationale triples in seven bounded groups of 25 and one of 22, without clipped output. A fourteen-change author precision stage removed weak 2:47 and ambiguous 4:17/18 wife-pronoun links, added exact Caleb-son-of-Jephonne 4:15→6:41 after reading 6:39–41, and refined ten wording or target scopes. I separately reread all eleven retained corrected complete triples. A second two-row precision stage restricted 1:41/42 to their unique Deson/Osar branches rather than equating repeated Ana/Daison names; I separately reread both complete corrected triples. Final retained coverage is 195 distinct supported source units and 195 pairs; ten read source units remain deferred with zero credit. Same-chapter links require an actual named family branch, explicit grammatical continuation or referent, particular royal succession, named-group action, or continuous campaign. This is an initial curated supplied-English pass, not exhaustive discovery, original-language or apparatus verification, independent human specialist approval, or certification of differing person, family, place, number, or transliteration identities.
pin_method: Fresh raw fixed-commit fetches for every retained source/target book. Each Git blob SHA1 was recomputed against the existing immutable source identity registry, complete parsed-cache equality was checked, and raw SHA256 values were saved. All nine saved raw blobs and full parsed-cache equality were checked again at freeze. Newline byte differences are separately recorded. All identities were already present in the thirteen-book source-check registry; no new target-book metadata identity was needed. Technical and inventory checks earn zero source or pair credit.
